name: Terminal Agent Adapter Guardrails
scope: Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, OpenClaw, local models
rules: Adapters translate the same work-order contract; no agent gets special doctrine.
High-cost models handle ambiguous reasoning; low-cost models handle bounded microtasks.
Adapter failure should not corrupt continuity state or plan state.
Execute-mode adapters must run in run-scoped isolation and preserve rollback evidence.
No default adapter writes outside run workspace without explicit approval policy.
